'''Imperial File #312485.34a''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report detailing the possibility that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] past working as a farmer on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] could have been a cover story.
